name: @projexlight/design-system
summary: Shared React component primitives for the apps/* surfaces — Button, Input, DataTable, Dialog, Toast, Form. Consumes branding kit at runtime so the same components render with each tenant's colors + logo in white-label deployments.

hooks.name: ThemeProvider
hooks.description: React provider that loads the active branding kit + exposes theme tokens to children.

scenarios.title: Apps wrap their root in ThemeProvider
scenarios.when_to_use: Every Next.js app — wraps the root layout in ThemeProvider so child components inherit the kit.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Every component below the provider gets the current kit's tokens. Server-rendered pages match client-rendered hydration.

scenarios.title: Use Button with built-in variants
scenarios.when_to_use: Any page needing a CTA — use the shared Button so accessibility + spacing stay consistent.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Renders with tenant's primary color. Keyboard + screen-reader behavior consistent across apps.

scenarios.title: DataTable renders a paginated list of rows
scenarios.when_to_use: Admin lists (contacts, invoices, leads) — DataTable handles sort/filter/paginate + URL state sync.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Server-driven pagination works without writing per-page code. ARIA roles + keyboard navigation built-in.

compliance_posture.notes: Components ship WCAG 2.1 AA compliance — focus rings, ARIA labels, keyboard nav. Audited per release.
